description: Search directory listings by query/category/tag (unranked educational match). Education only, not financial advice.

category.description: Optional exact category name to filter by (case-insensitive), e.g. Hardware wallet or Nostr client. Omit for all categories.

q.description: Optional free-text query matched against listing id, name, category, description and tags (case-insensitive). Omit to return all listings.

tag.description: Optional exact tag to filter by (case-insensitive), e.g. self-custody or nostr. Omit for all tags.

name: search_directory
title: Search directory
